notes.title: Pretty Girls Tile Match update Ver. 1.0.2 is now available!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944470/2ff82cfce8412e007bc3d278271611f3e487941d.png

Thank you for playing Pretty Girls Tile Match!
Pretty Girls Tile Match update Ver. 1.0.2 is now available!

Version 1.0.2 Update
Fixed a bug where clearing all mahjong tiles may not result in a stage clear.
Fixed a bug where the "MOVE" feature in support may not function properly.
Fixed a bug where opening the pause menu immediately after clearing a stage may cause the game to become unplayable.
Fixed a bug where character and stamp operation buttons may not be displayed in the dressing room diorama under certain conditions.
Made other minor adjustments and changes.
